mapper.select: SELECT pay_id,pay_ym,pay_plan_dt,pay_amt,pay_stts_cd,pay_src_cd,pay_se_cd,src_rec_id, cry_pay_id,updated_at,rcvr_nm,bank_cd,acnt_no,dpstr_nm FROM fin.pay WHERE pay_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT pay_id FROM fin.pay WHERE pay_src_cd='AUTO_FIN' AND pay_se_cd='CORP_TAX' AND src_rec_id=#{taxPayId} AND cry_pay_id IS NULL AND pay_stts_cd!='CANCEL' ORDER BY pay_id LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.pay WHERE cry_pay_id=#{id} AND pay_stts_cd!='CANCEL')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt),0)::bigint FROM fin.pay_execution WHERE pay_id=#{id}
SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE fin.corp_tax_pay t SET pay_dt=#{date},pay_amt=(SELECT SUM(e.pay_amt)::bigint FROM fin.pay_execution e WHERE e.pay_id=#{paymentId}) FROM fin.pay p WHERE p.pay_id=#{paymentId} AND p.pay_src_cd='AUTO_FIN' AND p.pay_se_cd='CORP_TAX' AND t.tax_pay_id=p.src_rec_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys.data_chg_hist(tbl_nm,obj_rec_id,data_chg_ty_cd,clmn_nm,bfr_val,aft_val,chg_user_id) VALUES('fin.pay',CAST(#{paymentId} AS text),'UPDATE','pay_execution', CAST((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt),0)-#{amount} FROM fin.pay_execution WHERE pay_id=#{paymentId}) AS text), CAST((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amt),0) FROM fin.pay_execution WHERE pay_id=#{paymentId}) AS text),#{actor})
